marks.gloss_en: שם טחינה אחת היא -- grinding is one name, so the atoned grinding draws the other

ומי אית ליה לרבא גרירה? והא איתמר -- Rava himself ruled in the forbidden-fat case that an offering for the first does not draw the third; how can he say reaping draws reaping? (amoraic-memra contradiction; no ObjectionKind names והא איתמר, svara stands in)
Abaye: grinding too draws grinding [the opposite grinding is atoned as well]
חלוקין לחטאות, ולא מצטרפין -- being separate for sin-offerings, they do not combine

[unwitting of Shabbat / intentional of the labours, and intentional of Shabbat / unwitting of the labours] are separate with regard to sin-offerings -- the matter obvious to Abaye and Rava (identification of the 'matter' is a reading; see header)
ורבי יהושע היא, דאמר תמחויין מחלקין
R' Yehoshua: dishes separate [prohibited food eaten from two dishes counts separately]
ורבי יהושע היא, דאמר תמחויין מחלקין
מר ארישא מתני לה וקשיא ליה, אנן אסיפא מתנינן לה ולא קשיא לן -- we learn Reish Lakish's okimta on the latter clause (two dishes -> exempt), so there is no case of separate-yet-combining
Reish Lakish (as the answerer learns it, on the latter clause): 'two kinds -- exempt' is really one kind; it is called two kinds because he ate it from two dishes, and is R' Yehoshua
בתר דשמעה מאביי סברה -- after he heard it from Abaye he adopted it
אי הכי, טחינה נמי תגרר לטחינה -- if Rava now holds drawing, the opposite grinding should be drawn too
גרירה אית ליה, גרירה דגרירה לית ליה -- the earlier grinding was itself only drawn by the reaping, and what was drawn does not draw further (= p_ein_gerira_degerira)
Rava: if he brought it for the third, the third and second are atoned, the first is not

וכל היכא דחלוקין לחטאות לא מצטרפי? והתנן... -- by Reish Lakish's okimta, the mishna's 'half and half of one kind, liable' is two dishes, which R' Yehoshua holds separate for sin-offerings; here they are separate and yet combine!
the mishna: one who ate forbidden fat and forbidden fat in one lapse of awareness is liable only one [sin-offering]
Rava: where he became aware first of the reaping and grinding done unwitting of Shabbat, then of those done unwitting of the labours -- reaping draws reaping and grinding draws grinding
